NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and conditions contained herein, it is
hereby agreed as follows:
1.The ASSOCIATION shall perform the following services during the 2019, 2020 and 2021
Men's/Women’s and Co-Rec softball leagues or any additional softball leagues/tournaments which could be
developed during the term of this Agreement:
a.The ASSOCIATION shall provide and assign two(2)umpires and one (1) scorekeeper to officiate
to officiate at each Co-Rec adult city league softball game according tothe schedules provided to the
ASSOCIATION by the CITY prior to each league.The ASSOCIATION shall provide the CITY with a schedule
of theumpires and score keepers assigned to each adult cityleague softball game at thestart of each period, with
said schedule covering at least a two (2) week period of each league.The ASSOCIATION agrees to pay the
CITY a fine equal to the current one game fee for each day beyond the deadline that the schedule is late.(See
Section 4a.forfines).
b.The ASSOCIATION shall annually, no later than April 30, provide the CITY with lists setting
forth the names and phone numbers of all ASSOCIATION personnel, officers, umpires and score keepers. The
ASSOCIATION shall update such lists when changes occur.
c.The ASSOCIATION shall ensure that all umpires and score keepers assigned to city league
softball games are properly trained and perform their duties in accordance with the current City League By-Laws
and the National Association Code and Rule Book, which are incorporated by this reference as thoughfully set
forth herein.Copies of the aforementioned City League By-Laws are available from the Cheyenne Recreation
Division,1317Parsley Blvd., Cheyenne, Wyoming 82007.The ASSOCIATION agrees to encourage all umpires
to register and certify with the current National Association chosen by the CITY.Any umpire or scorekeeper
deemed by the CITY not to be properly trained can be prohibited by the CITYfrom working any city league
softball game.The CITYwill provide the ASSOCIATION written notice thereof by certified mail sent to the last
known address of the principal office of the ASSOCIATION.

d.The ASSOCIATION hereby agrcesthat it shall developa training team and process whereby prior
to each season, umpires and score keepers are trained by the ASSOCIATION.The ASSOCIATION further agrees
to provide the CITYwith satisfactory written documentation of the training program process as well as a pre-
season schedule of training sessions, an agenda for each of these sessions, and a complete listingof all umpires
and score keepers attending the pre-season session.Upon request, the ASSOCIATION further agrees to provide
the CITY a detailed written report documenting the grade each individual received in training, ranking them as
passing, failing or incomplete. These materials must be received by the CITY within two (2) weeks after the
request has been made. Any umpire or scorekeeper that does not successfully complete the training program will
not be scheduled towork a city league softball game until the individual completes the training program
successfully and appropriate documentation of completion is delivered to the CITY.The ASSOCIATION shall
be fined an amount equal to the current season’s one game feeforeach day beyond the deadline that the required
information and reports are not submitted to the CITY.(See Section 4a.for fines).
e.The ASSOCIATION agrees to develop and implement an evaluation process whereby each
umpire's and scorekeeper's performance is evaluated during thefirst ten(10) weeks of the initial league eachyear
during the term of this Agreement.The ASSOCIATION further agrees to provide a written report to the CITY
detailing the evaluation of anumpire and score keeper at therequest of theleague director withinfive(5)working
days of said request for each season during the term of this Agreement.The ASSOCIATION shall befined an
amount equal to the current season's one gamefeefor each daybeyond thedeadline that therequired information
and reports are not submitted to the CITY.(See Section 4a.for fines).
f.The ASSOCIATION scorekeeper shall keep and maintain a score book, score report form and
distribute lineup cards for each game. The scorekeeper shall mark the official starting time for each game in the
scorebook and enter thefirst initial andlast names ofeach playerinto the score book.The scorekeeper shall also
fill out the score report form and have the umpires signthe score book after eachgame to verify the score of each
game and then the scorekeeper shall turn in the score report form to the CITY softball supervisor at the ballfield.
The ASSOCIATION shall be fined for(a)failure to turn in the score report form and/or (b)for each game score
not reported or reported incorrectly.(See Section 4a.for fines).
g.The ASSOCIATION shall report all player ejections to the CITY, at the Recreation Offices at
1317Parsley Blvd., on the form provided by the CITY within two (2) working days of the ejection.It is the
responsibility ofthe ejecting umpire tofill out and deliversaid ejection report to the CITY.A fine will be assessed
to the ASSOCIATION for each player ejection not reported and received within the two (2)working day period.
(See Section 4a.for fines).The CITY will notify the ASSOCIATION of player's date of return.

2.The ASSOCIATION hereby covenants and agrees that should it fail to provide the proper number
of umpires and score keepers in a timely manner as required by this Agreement, it shall pay the CITY fines for
each failure as per the following guidelines.(See Section 4a.for fines).
a.If an umpire/scorekeeper failsto sign in ten(10) minutes priorto scheduled game time:
- One half the current umpire fee per umpire.
-Onehalf the current score keeper fee per scorekeeper.
b.If anygame starts as scheduled with lessthan the proper numberof ASSOCIATION officials, the
following fines shall be added, in addition to the fines outlined above:
UMPIRES:
- One half the current umpire fee when a second umpire arrives prior to the start of the 3rd inning.
-The current umpire fee ifa second umpire arrives after the start of the 3rd inning.
-The current umpire fee if a game is worked by only oneumpire.
SCORE KEEPERS:
-Onehalf the current score keeper fee if the scorekeeper arrives prior to the start of the 3rd inning.
-The current scorekeeper fee if the scorekeeper arrives after the start of the 3rd inning.
-The current scorekeeper fee if the game is worked without an ASSOCIATION scorekeeper.
c.If any game cannot start within one-half (/2) hour of the scheduled game time, with at least one (1)
ASSOCIATION umpire and scorekeeper, the ASSOCIATION will be fined the current game fee.As an
additional penalty, the ASSOCIATION shall provide and assign the proper number of umpires and score keepers
to officiate an additional game at no additional cost to the CITY.(See Section 4a.for fines).
3.The CITY shall pay the ASSOCIATION:
a.For each game scored and officiated by the ASSOCIATION. (See Section 4b.for fees).
b.The parties mutually agree that if inclement weather begins afterthe umpires and score keeper have
arrived for the first scheduled game and the game is canceled before being started, the ASSOCIATION will
receive travel pay.The parties further agree that themaximum delaydue to inclement weather will be thirty(30)
minutes. (See Section 4b.for fees).
c.The parties mutually agree that if a game is canceled afterbeing started but beforeit is considered
a complete game, the ASSOCIATION will be paid the full amount of the current game fee if the game is past the
start of the second inning, and one-halfofthe current game feeif the game is called priorto the start ofthe second
inning.The ASSOCIATION shall be paid the full fee upon rescheduling of said games.

The CITYwill not befined if the CITY notifies the ASSOCIA TON of games being canceled due to
inclement weather or other circumstances before 4:00 p.m.(See Section 4b.forfees).
d.The CITY shall also pay the ASSOCIATION an annual fee for administrative services and a per
gamefee, exclusive of make-up games, for scheduling services.Saidfees shall be paid by the CITY along with
the game fees as outlined in Section 3e.below. (See Section 4b.for fees).
e.Payment for thefirst 400 games to be officiated by the ASSOCIATION for the initial league each
subsequent games tobe officiated by the ASSOCIATION for the balance of theinitial league asscheduled by the
CITY shall be paid prior to the mid-point of the initial league by the CITY.Payment for games in subsequent
leagues for each season as scheduled by the CITY shall be paid by the CITY within two (2) weeks of the start of
the subsequent leagues.
f.Within thirty(30) days after the conclusion of each league, the CITY will pay for any games
officiated by the ASSOCIATION not covered by prior payment.Additionally, any adjustments for fines or
overpayment to the ASSOCIATION by theCITYwill be accounted for, and any refund or amount owed to the
CITY by the ASSOCIATION willbe paid by the ASSOCIATION within the same thirty (30) day period.
g.The ASSOCIATION will not be required to officiate forfeited games.It is mutually agreed and
understood that no scheduled week night games will be playedif any of the games preceding them onthat field
for that day have been canceled due to weather.It isfurther agreed that on weekends, the decision to cancel one
or more games at a given field will not prohibit games on that field from resuming at a time specified by the
CITY.
h.The CITY shall provide a U.S.S.S.A.sanctioned league and maintain any and all requirements for
such sanctioning.
4.The following schedules detail thefines andfees ineffect during the term of this Agreement.Fines
and fees are (a)based on per umpire per game pay of $25.00 in 2019, 2020 and 2021, as well as scorekeeper fees
per game of $15.00 in 2019, 2020 and 2021 for the Men’s and Women’s soft bal leagues/tournaments, and (b)
based on one umpire per game pay of $35.00 in 2019, 2020 and 2021, as well as scorekeeper fees per game of
$15.00 in 2019, 2020 and 2021 for the Co-Rec softball leagues.
